rationale: The Court is likely to adopt a Kagan/Roberts-style structural holding that § 3582(c)(1)(A) cannot be triggered by freestanding § 2255-type claims of legal invalidity, while allowing intervening law and inequities to be considered under § 3553(a) once eligibility is otherwise established. Expect at least one dissent (Sotomayor, possibly joined by Jackson) emphasizing text and Concepcion, and a meaningful chance of a Thomas/Alito concurrence sharpening the anti-circumvention/finality rationale.
